propositions: Characterization test suite must pin exact output values for all units about to be extracted from adapters/jira/ to prevent silent mapping regressions during shared code movement.
Every value map key and documented default fallback (To Do/Medium) must have explicit exact-value assertions covering both branches and unmapped key behavior.
Sanitizer functions must be tested at, below, and above their size limits, and all rejection paths must preserve the deliberate off-by-one encodings.

Identity convention parsing and formatting including legacy hyphen forms, link relation vocabulary and directionality inversions, and probe classification for all HTTP branches must be pinned with literal expected values.
Test mutation of three source values must demonstrably cause corresponding characterization tests to fail, proving the oracle gates regressions.
Zero source code changes in src/ directory; only test extension in test_backend_characterization.py.
